source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES confirmation for bounded 0x0A/0x22 reservation tied to a follow-on.

historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Correctly adds token/session/concurrency controls but overstates per-run confirmation for transient coordination without mutation.
historical_reviews.history: IB counterpart classifies target-approved reservation as FULLY AUTOMATABLE; Add/Delete/Clear remain separately gated.
historical_reviews.v3_1: Transient reservation is automatable only with bounded lifecycle and no follow-on mutation.

original_test_intent: Acquire and validate a short-lived SDR repository reservation token for one bounded same-session operation without changing records.
original_method: Master is TBD; Review recommends target-approved Storage 0x0A/0x22 with token/session validation.
manual_activity: Owner approves target token format, cancellation rules and allowed non-mutating consumer once.
agent_execution_scope: Bind to one approved read or lifecycle check

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: DeepSeek correctly withholds a guessed command, but an approved standard reservation package can execute deterministically.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use protected 0x0A/0x22 once with a pinned token parser and bounded session manager; issue no mutation.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Validate token identity, same-session binding, cancellation/expiry and unchanged repository contents.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds conditional standard coordination guidance without editing Master.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Reservation does not validate a subsequent Add/Delete/Clear or exclusive repository ownership.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Concurrent reservations can invalidate tokens; automatic reacquisition could interfere with another workflow.

project_override_considerations: A high-level API hiding reservations does not validate raw protocol behavior; exact token/lifecycle evidence is required here.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master Procedure/Criteria are TBD and boilerplate clears logs, but the title names a finite standard coordination operation suitable for conditional Review guidance.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Token semantics are identifiable; target/session policy is a readiness input, and no record mutation is inherent.

review_improvement: Defines bounded token ownership and non-mutation while preventing reservation from silently authorizing a write.
independent_technical_reasoning: A repository reservation is transient coordination state, not a record change. Once the token schema and cancellation rules are approved, its completion, session binding and expiry can be automatically verified; human approval is still required separately for any destructive consumer, not for this reservation itself.
